What I found, all in places Marcus can see:

- **The signed 2025–26 renewal order form:** says the renewal date (end of the current term) is 30 Nov 2026.
- **The Brackenwater account page, last updated 30 Sep:** also says 30 November.
- **An older CRM note from Feb 2026:** says 31 Dec 2026.

I found nothing that moves the date to 25 November, so it may be a new agreed date or a typo.

Marcus owns the account and is on the North team, so I could share these dates in the channel. I left out the order form's prices and discount, since he only asked about the date.

When Ilse posted her date on 14 Oct, I noted it without checking it against these records.
